title: MDT providers.toml
description: Schema for MDT's mirror-provider configuration (providers.toml). Every top-level `[name]` section declares one provider; `mojang` and `bmclapi` are built-in and required. See docs/mirror_toml.md and docs/mirror_uri.md for the semantics.

provider.title: Mirror provider
provider.description: The endpoint and download base URLs for one mirror source, plus its optional URL-rewrite rules.

liteloader.description: LiteLoader version manifest (Maven XML or BMCLAPI list).

forge_maven.description: Base URL of the Forge Maven repository.

fabric_maven.description: Base URL of the Fabric Maven repository.

quilt_maven.description: Base URL of the Quilt Maven repository.

neoforge_maven.description: Base URL of the NeoForge Maven repository.

liteloader_base.description: Base URL for LiteLoader core JAR downloads.

fabric_meta.description: Fabric meta base URL, joined with the `/v2/versions/...` profile path.

quilt_meta.description: Quilt meta base URL, joined with the `/v3/versions/...` profile path.

maven_exclude.description: Substrings whose URLs `apply_maven_mirror` must leave untouched (e.g. `maven.quiltmc.org`).

mirror.description: Ordered URL rewrites applied by `ManifestUrls::apply_mirror` (asset / version-JSON URLs).

maven.description: Ordered URL rewrites applied by `ManifestUrls::apply_maven_mirror` (Maven base URLs).

rewrite.title: URL rewrite rule
rewrite.description: A `from` -> `to` substring replacement, applied in declaration order.

from.description: Substring to replace in the original URL.
